// Modbus tag map: Used when DRIVER=modbus. Keys starting with // are comments.
// Names: Any name you like; screens use it as the tag. These match the demo screen.
// Addresses: CLICK PLC addresses shown (C1 = 016385, DS1 = 400001, DD1 = 416385, DF1 = 428673). Check yours in the PLC software.
// Types: BOOL (coils 0xxxxx, inputs 1xxxxx), INT, UINT, DINT, UDINT, REAL, STRING (registers 3xxxxx, 4xxxxx).
// Strings: STRING also needs length, the max characters. Example: { "address": "400101", "type": "STRING", "length": 20, "writable": true }
// Analog: Add min, max and eu to show a number as ST_Analog (for SetpointEntry and AnalogReadout).
